issues.description: Synchronous readFileSync in getSourceMap blocks reporter loop with no caching across frames
issues.detail: getSourceMap runs per stack frame and does existsSync + readFileSync + convert-source-map parse for every external file, with no memoization. Deep stacks or many failing tests cause repeated O(frames * filesize) sync I/O on the main reporter path. Add a per-run Map<file, SourceMap|undefined> cache.

issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) changes resolution semantics and lacks a direct unit test
issues.detail: Swapping resolve(s, from) for resolve(from, '..', s) assumes 'from' is always a file path so '..' strips the filename. This breaks when 'from' is a directory, a URL (http://, file://), or already normalized, shifting the base directory up one level. Add a focused unit test in packages/utils covering relative, absolute, and URL-style 'from'/sourceRoot values.

issues.description: No try/catch around sync I/O and source-map parsing inside getSourceMap
issues.detail: readFileSync and convertSourceMap.fromSource/fromMapFileSource can throw on permission errors, TOCTOU races, malformed base64, or invalid JSON. An uncaught throw inside getSourceMap aborts parseErrorStacktrace and replaces the user's real test failure with a source-map crash. Wrap in try/catch and fall back to undefined.

issues.description: Fallback '{}' from createConvertSourceMapReadMap is not a valid v3 source map
issues.detail: When the referenced .map file is missing, the helper returns '{}', which lacks version/mappings/sources. Depending on convert-source-map and trace-mapping versions this may throw or silently produce empty mappings rather than signalling absence. Return a minimal valid v3 stub or let absence propagate explicitly.

issues.description: Mixing pathe and node:path imports in test-run.ts risks Windows path inconsistencies
issues.detail: The file already imports resolve from pathe for cross-platform normalization, but the new helpers import node:path and call path.resolve/path.dirname. On Windows these produce backslash separators, diverging from Vite/Vitest's normalized forward-slash module-graph keys. Use pathe consistently.

issues.description: Importing SourceMap type from 'rollup' is the wrong type for a convert-source-map value
issues.detail: extractSourcemapFromFile is annotated with rollup's SourceMap, but the value comes from convertSourceMap.toObject() (RawSourceMap shape) and may not match rollup's stricter type. Since @types/convert-source-map is now available, use its type or a local shape to avoid coupling test-run.ts to rollup's surface.

synthesis.summary: The PR fixes source-map resolution for external module stack traces by adding a getSourceMap hook in TestRun and reordering resolve() arguments in DecodedMap. The panel agrees the fix is correct in spirit, with the snapshot confirming end-to-end behavior. Main consensus concerns: the new sync readFileSync path runs per stack frame with no caching and no error handling, risking reporter stalls and replacing real test errors with source-map crashes. The resolve(from, '..', s) change needs a direct unit test, the '{}' fallback is not a valid source map, and minor hygiene issues exist around pathe/node:path mixing and the rollup SourceMap type import.
